findings.text: Safety post-training uses deliberative alignment: a curated reasoning trace then a policy-conditioned final response, plus a content-moderation filter on unsafe outputs.

source.quote:
Following the deliberative alignment framework (Guan et al., 2025), we adopt a two-stage generation
process in which the reasoning trace and the final response are curated separately but consistently
with our response policy.

findings.text: An explicit response-policy framework chooses among helpline support, refusal with brief explanation, or answering only the benign part of a mixed request.

source.quote:
These response modes specify whether the
model should provide supportive resources such as helpline information, issue a refusal with a brief
explanation, or answer the benign portion of the request while ignoring malicious content.
